gaps.title: No Canonical State Serialization Format
gaps.description: Handoffs use informal context packaging - no schema defines what must be serialized
examples: Agent A sends JSON, Agent B expects dict
Session IDs not mandatory in handoff context
Decision history not included in auto_handoff.py extraction

gaps.title: Implicit Handoff Success Criteria
gaps.description: No formal validation contract - success determined ad-hoc by receiving agent
examples: validate_handoff.py has optional checks (pass/warn/fail severity levels)
No mandatory fields enforced before handoff
Validation report generated but not enforced

gaps.title: No Rollback Mechanism for Failed Handoffs
gaps.description: Handoff failures cannot be automatically rolled back to previous state
examples: track_handoffs.py can mark as 'failed' but doesn't restore previous state
Session Resume Engine has fallback_strategy but not rollback

gaps.title: Handoff Audit Trail is Optional
gaps.description: No mandatory logging of handoff events - tracing failed handoffs is manual
examples: Tracking file is JSON but not versioned
No cryptographic signatures on handoff records
Comment-based tracking loses context if PR updated

missing_elements.required_for: Ensuring all handoffs contain required fields
Resuming after failure at exact interruption point

preserved_elements.notes: Only captured from recent entries; early work lost if log rotated
Preserved if files remain accessible; relative paths may break
Captured at specific times; intermediate metrics lost
Complete if workflow finishes; partial if interrupted
Loses context if PR updated during handoff

lost_elements.reason: Only high-level decisions recorded, detailed reasoning lost
lost_elements.impact: Agent B cannot understand 'why' behind decisions

lost_elements.reason: Only final state saved, not intermediate snapshots
lost_elements.impact: Cannot resume at exact interruption point

lost_elements.reason: Errors logged but recovery state not preserved
Patterns loaded from store but not personalized per session
Agent capabilities registered but not passed to successor
lost_elements.impact: Successor agent may not have optimal configuration

inconsistencies.description: Handoff context format varies between agents
inconsistencies.example: auto_handoff.py uses HandoffContext dataclass; orchestrator uses plain dict; session_enrichment uses nested JSON
inconsistencies.impact: Receiving agent must parse multiple formats

inconsistencies.example: Workflow Navigator saves state per workflow; Agent Memory saves per session; Auto Handoff captures per-phase
inconsistencies.impact: Cannot correlate state across agent boundaries

inconsistencies.example: Some use ISO8601+Z, some use Unix epoch, some use local datetime
inconsistencies.impact: Ordering and correlation of events becomes unreliable

inconsistencies.example: Relative paths in deliverables vs absolute paths in context vs URLs in enrichment
inconsistencies.impact: File references may become invalid after handoff

inconsistencies.example: Orchestra stores errors as dicts; workflow_navigator as strings; session_resume as exceptions
inconsistencies.impact: Error handling and recovery logic duplicated across agents

gaps.description: No unified state dictionary shared across agents
gaps.consequence: Each agent maintains separate state trees; no global view
gaps.required_solution: Implement AgentStateStore with concurrent access control

gaps.description: No state versioning or temporal tracking
gaps.consequence: Cannot traverse state history to understand how state evolved
gaps.required_solution: Implement state change log with versioning

gaps.consequence: If multiple agents modify overlapping state during handoff, conflict undefined
gaps.required_solution: Implement conflict detection and resolution policy

gaps.consequence: Any agent can read/write any state; no isolation guarantees
gaps.required_solution: Implement access control list per state fields

missing_persistence.problem: No history tracking; patterns not correlated with outcomes
missing_persistence.required: State history database with query API

missing_persistence.problem: No guarantees on consistency; eventual consistency at best

transition_failures.title: Silent state loss during handoff
transition_failures.scenario: Agent A transfers work to Agent B via comment; some fields are skipped
transition_failures.consequence: Agent B operates on incomplete state without awareness
transition_failures.detection: Can only be detected post-hoc by comparing final output
transition_failures.evidence: session_context_enrichment.py explicitly mentions 'context loss from 20% to <5%' - implying current loss is high

transition_failures.title: Handoff timeout without recovery
transition_failures.scenario: Agent A sends handoff; Agent B timeout before receiving (AGENT_HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=120 in agent_context.json)
transition_failures.consequence: Work state stranded; no automatic retry or rollback
transition_failures.detection: Requires manual monitoring; no alert mechanism
transition_failures.evidence: timeout configured but no recovery logic found

transition_failures.title: Implicit handoff without acknowledgment
transition_failures.scenario: Orchestrator routes work to agent; agent silently ignores if overloaded
transition_failures.consequence: Work never executed; no notification to sender
transition_failures.detection: Only discovered when checking agent status manually
transition_failures.evidence: agent_orchestrator.py routes but doesn't verify receipt

transition_failures.title: Partial state transfer on network failure
transition_failures.scenario: Handoff comment posted mid-update; some deliverables listed, some incomplete
transition_failures.consequence: Agent B sees partial work; makes decisions on incomplete info
transition_failures.detection: Requires explicit validation of all deliverables
transition_failures.evidence: validate_handoff.py has optional validation, not mandatory

transition_failures.title: Handoff with unresolved dependencies
transition_failures.scenario: Agent A hands off while depending on external service that fails
transition_failures.consequence: Agent B inherits broken dependency without context
transition_failures.detection: No dependency check performed before handoff

missing_validation.title: State Completeness Check
missing_validation.description: Before handoff, validate that all required state fields are present
missing_validation.current_impl: validate_handoff.py checks fields but not mandatory
missing_validation.gap: Validation is opt-in (--pre-check flag), not enforced
missing_validation.impact: Incomplete handoffs can pass through undetected

missing_validation.title: State Consistency Validation
missing_validation.description: Verify state is internally consistent (no contradictions)
missing_validation.gap: No consistency checking between related fields (e.g., completed_tasks should be subset of all_tasks)
missing_validation.impact: Agent B may make decisions based on contradictory state

missing_validation.title: Deliverable Accessibility Check
missing_validation.description: Verify all referenced deliverables are accessible
missing_validation.gap: Only checks if files exist; doesn't verify readability or content integrity
missing_validation.impact: Deliverables may be listed but inaccessible

missing_validation.title: Dependency Resolution Validation
missing_validation.description: Verify all external dependencies are available
missing_validation.gap: No check for required services, APIs, or resources before handoff
missing_validation.impact: Agent B fails immediately if dependencies unavailable

missing_validation.title: Format Validation
missing_validation.description: Validate handoff message conforms to expected schema
missing_validation.current_impl: No JSON schema; templates provided but not enforced
missing_validation.gap: No schema validation; templates are documentation only
missing_validation.impact: Agent B must parse variable formats

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: Agent A decides when to hand off based on internal heuristics
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.explicit_gap: No formal trigger specification; criteria undefined
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: Handoffs can occur at suboptimal times

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: Orchestrator selects next agent based on failure type
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.explicit_gap: Selection criteria not documented; no prioritization policy
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: Multiple valid agents might be available; selection non-deterministic

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: Each component serializes state as it sees fit (JSON, dict, pickle)
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.explicit_gap: No format specification; receiver must handle all formats
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: State may be corrupted during deserialization

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: Handoff failure behavior varies per agent
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: Some agents retry silently; others fail immediately; behavior unpredictable

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: State created by Agent A implicitly owned by Agent A
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.explicit_gap: No ownership specification; unclear who can modify which fields
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: Concurrent modification leads to race conditions

implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.implicit: Resume means 'continue from last known point' but exact point undefined
implicit_vs_explicit_gaps.consequence: Resume may re-execute completed work or skip incomplete work
